facts.text: House3D is a virtual 3D environment of thousands of indoor scenes sourced from the SUNCG dataset, with over 45k indoor 3D scenes
Agents observe RGB images, depth, segmentation masks and top-down 2D map views
RoomNavTask is a gym.Env subclass
RoomNavTask requires its env argument to be an Environment instance
The constructor defaults segment_input=True, joint_visual_signal=False, depth_signal=True and discrete_action=False
The observation space is Box(0, 255) with shape (resolution[0], resolution[1], n_channel), where n_channel starts at 3, gains 3 for joint_visual_signal and 1 for depth_signal
The pixel criteria are stated for the default resolution 120 x 90

The thirteen discrete actions are forward, left, right, left-forward, right-forward, rotate left, rotate right, backward, small forward, small left, small right, small rotate left and small rotate right
n_discrete_actions is len(discrete_actions)
discrete_action=True selects spaces.Discrete(n_discrete_actions); otherwise the action space is a Tuple of Box(0, 1, (4,)) and Box(0, 1, (2,))
rotation_sensitivity is 30 degrees per time step and default_move_sensitivity is 0.5
success_distance_range is 1.0, success_stay_time_steps is 5 and success_see_target_time_steps is 2
The reward constants are collision_penalty_reward 0.3, stay_room_reward 0.1 and success_reward 10
reset clears the episode counters, resets the house and target, draws a birth place with random.choice, teleports the environment and returns the rendered observation

step scales the action tuple by move_sensitivity and rot_sensitivity, rotates then moves, charges the collision penalty when move_forward returns False, adds the in-room reward at distance zero and adds the success reward when _is_success returns True
max_steps > 0 ends the episode when current_episode_step reaches max_steps
Environment.info returns house_id, loc, yaw, grid, front and right
RoomNavTask.info adds dist, scaled_dist, optsteps, collision and target_room
move_forward translates by the forward and horizontal distances and returns whether move accepted the new position
rotate adds the degrees to the camera yaw
Environment.reset teleports the agent to x, y and yaw and draws a random connected coordinate and a yaw in [-180, 180) when they are not given
Setting seed in Environment seeds numpy and Python's random module
MultiHouseEnv builds one House per id in a multiprocessing Pool and reset_house selects a house by index or at random
The upstream install requirements are gym and numpy only

determinism.notes: reset(seed) reseeds the Python random.Random that draws the birth cell and yaw, and the stand-in's motion is deterministic; the upstream task seeds numpy and Python's random module in its constructor (House3D/roomnav.py:137-139).  One tick is one navigation step, not a fixed physics interval, so timestep_ms is 0.

gaps: the fake is a kinematic 5x5 grid stand-in, not the SUNCG renderer: no RGB, depth or semantic rendering, no house geometry, no collision mesh and no SUNCG data

the upstream observation is a Box of shape (resolution[0], resolution[1], n_channel), (120, 90, 4) at the default resolution named in House3D/roomnav.py:58 with the defaults of :82-84 and :119-127; the fake returns a 4x4x4 coarse array (marked placeholder in fake.py) to keep receipts small
the reward is reduced to the collision penalty, the in-room reward and the success reward; the linear, indicator, delta and speed shaping of step() (House3D/roomnav.py:324-345) is not modelled

success is modelled as being within success_distance_range of the target for success_see_target_time_steps steps; the upstream 'see' criterion counts semantic pixels of target objects (n_pixel_for_object_see at House3D/roomnav.py:57-60)
the continuous Tuple action space (House3D/roomnav.py:135) is not modelled: the fake uses discrete_action=True and Discrete(13), the alternative the upstream constructor offers
reset accepts seed and options as the gymnasium bridge requires; the upstream reset takes only a target and seeds in the constructor (House3D/roomnav.py:77-87, 215)

the upstream environment could not be run here: objrender is a compiled pybind extension (House3D/roomnav.py:18) and SUNCG data, config.json and OpenCV are required (INSTRUCTION.md:59-63); the fake was never compared with it
snapshot and restore are not offered: RoomNavTask has set_state but no get_state

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the world state is kept and stays readable
